comments.author: sandesh-sp
comments.body: Not sure about this. In our current work flow, tools are defined in the panel through the mission config (or the tool builder), and we simply render whatever is configured there. Do we have any scenario where we'd need to dynamically remove tools?

comments.author: slesaad
comments.body:
when we have tool builder, and we wanted to preview the dashboard realtime with tool builder updates (instead of saving the config in a json and the dashboard reading from the json).

but can be done later too!

comments.author: sandesh-sp
comments.body: never mind, found a use case for `removeToolFromPanel`. It is needed for the tools that are temporarily mounted in the panel, like the AOI selector which gets activated after user clicks on "Analyze area" button.

comments.author: sandesh-sp
